name: Select Organization after Sign-in -> Organization Dashboard
journey_path: Existing Business Customer Registering & Logging-on to B2B Portal

automation_boundary.automated_scope: From an authenticated session without a default organization: Select a Organization to continue -> (optional) view cost centres -> choose organization -> Organization Dashboard rendered with navigation and widgets.
automation_boundary.external_boundary: Organization, Party ID and account data come from back-end systems. Assert what the portal renders against the test-data profile; do not query back-end systems.

steps.action: Complete sign-in with a user linked to several organizations and no default
steps.expected_result: Authentication completes and the organization chooser is displayed
steps.note: Authentication steps come from the sign-in journey (prerequisite_journeys).

steps.action: Verify the organization chooser lists every linked organization
steps.expected_result: 'Select a Organization to continue' is shown with one card per organization linked to the user

steps.action: Verify each organization card shows name, role, Trade License No, status badge and cost centre count
steps.expected_result: Every card displays organization name, the user's role (e.g. Customer Representative), 'Trade License No <n>', a status badge (e.g. ACTIVE) and 'N COST CENTERS (PARTY IDS) >'

steps.action: Open the cost centers (Party IDs) list from an organization card
steps.expected_result: An overlay titled 'N Cost centers(Party IDs) in your Organization' lists N tiles formatted '<PartyID> - <name>'
The overlay disappears and the organization chooser is shown again
steps.note: Dismiss mechanism is not shown in the PDF; the crawl must identify it.

steps.action: Click the organization card to choose it as the working organization
steps.expected_result: The Organization Dashboard for the chosen organization opens

steps.action: Verify the Organization Dashboard header shows the company profile control
steps.expected_result: The header shows the profile control '<display name> (<full name>)' and the navigation Dashboard, Manage, Pay, Order, Services, Support

steps.action: Verify the dashboard widgets ACCOUNTS, QUICK ACCESS, TOTAL DUE, ORDERS and SUPPORT TICKETS
steps.expected_result: All five widgets render; each shows data for the chosen organization or its documented empty state (e.g. 'No pending dues.')

conditional_branches.outcome: chooser is skipped; Organization Dashboard opens directly (flow not applicable)

test_scenarios.title: Multi-org user without default chooses an organization and reaches its dashboard
Organization cards show name, role, Trade License No, status and cost centre count
Cost centre list count matches the card and tiles follow '<PartyID> - <name>'
User with a default organization bypasses the chooser
Dashboard shows data of the chosen organization only (choose org A, then org B in a new session, compare)
Organization with no dues, orders or tickets shows the documented empty states
ACCOUNTS donut total equals 'N Active' and the sum of category rows

open_questions: How is the cost centres overlay dismissed?
Does choosing an organization here set it as default, or only for the session? (subtitle says 'set as default' -- mechanism not shown)
shared_note: Common tail of all three sign-in variants (OTP, e& Password, UAE PASS). Author its steps once here; variants chain to it through next_flows.
